title: DRE-LZSH: SEEG benchmark dataset for drug-resistant epilepsy (ictal and interictal segments, 29 patients)
description: Stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 29 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, comprising ictal and interictal segments together with clinical information and channel-level epileptogenic-zone annotations. The data are a lossless iEEG-BIDS re-packaging of the DRE-LZSH benchmark release (Zenodo 17272689), sampled at 2000 Hz, and are described by the associated TNSRE paper (doi:10.1109/TNSRE.2026.3702844). Authors' derived results (HFO rates, 1/f spectral fits) and analysis code are included. Caveat: the P014 epileptogenic-zone and deleted-channel annotations in the release appear to be a copy of the P007 row (several channel numbers exceed P014's channel count) and should not be used without confirmation from the authors.
methods_description: SEEG segments recorded at 2000 Hz, covering seizure (typically 40-60 s) and longer interictal segments. MATLAB arrays from the original release were converted to BrainVision float32 with BIDS sidecars, with no filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Electrode coordinates are not available.
